name: Tiko Radio
subtitle: Listening, made simple
promotional_text: A calm, ad-free audio player. Curated stations and stories, with simple controls anyone can use.
description:
Tiko Radio is a calm, simple audio player for children. Browse curated stations and stories, then play with one tap — big controls, no clutter, no ads.

Designed so even very young children can listen independently.

- One-tap play and stop
- Curated, child-friendly audio
- Big, friendly controls
- Works the moment it opens

Part of Tiko, a child-first universe of small, focused AAC tools.
